notes: The repository computes the trace and pairing through the rational sector measure B_m (kalgebra.md, proved equal to the printed infinite products); here the printed formulas are evaluated directly, so this is an independent check of that equality on the lines listed.  The class's pairing is the sector formula, so the comparison with Tr(ρ(f)·g) is a separate check (added 2026-09-23; before that the eq:Iexplicit row's conjectural half was tested only by tests/test_wrq_sector_pairing.py, 72 SU(2) and 32 SU(3) pairs).
